observed_title: Combining Constraint Programming Reasoning with Large Language Model Predictions

read_ranges.scope: 全文各节、Algorithm 1、Figures 1–4、Tables 1–5、讨论及参考文献

topic_relevance.basis: 生成式CSP的显式约束检验、回溯和域管理可迁移；LLM有限top-k域是模型的一部分，不能充当原数学问题的全域SAT/UNSAT证书。

definitions.name: GenCP(M,F)
definitions.statement: M=(X,D,C), variables words, domains LLM predicted words; F contains generative functions G, Boolean acceptance B, helpers H. genV/genD/genC create variables/domains/constraints during search.

theorem_cards.label: Algorithm 1 / generation-propagation-backtracking
assumptions: Finite generated candidate domains; all task structural constraints encoded and applied
Saved state includes variables, domains and constraints; after backtracking delete later generated objects
Acceptance Boolean checks task constraints and LLM predicts period; stopping/loop prevention is helper-dependent
theorem_cards.statement: Call generative functions, helpers, save state, propagate, evaluate acceptance, then save solution/backtrack; predicted domain wipeout leads to backtrack.
proof_steps: Propagated accepted assignments checked within generated model
No theorem in this source proves that top-k domains exhaust all language or original CSP solutions
gaps: p11 asserts guarantee every solution and monotonicity in k without proving nesting/determinism/termination of candidate domains. Those claims require fixed deterministic nested finite domain tree and exhaustive traversal; backtrackTo can skip completions.

constant_dependence.explicit: k, top-k sampling parameters and prompt determine candidate domain; experiment uses llama v1 7B Q4, temp=.8, CPU, Java17; runtime/memory figures are configuration-specific.

endpoint_limits.scope: Word-level text generation; structural constraints only. Meaning assessed by model PPL/human discussion.
endpoint_limits.not_established: Full-language unsatisfiability, global SAT completeness, or domain nesting for nondeterministic predictions.

reusable_methods.method: Explicitly manage model state and delete later generated variables/domains/constraints on backtracking
reusable_methods.transfer: Useful for dynamic finite CSP encoding; certify original constraints on accepted assignments.

reusable_methods.method: Separate proposal domain from hard structural constraint filter
reusable_methods.transfer: Heuristic proposal omission must remain a search incompleteness flag; no solution found is not original UNSAT.

checked_derivation.statement: A one-variable original domain {a,b} with hard x=b is SAT. Predicted domain {a} filters to empty; search exhausts generated model yet original model remains SAT.

unchecked: Source empirical benchmark was not rerun; no external LLM call is made.
All source pages read; quoted literature reference proofs not independently read.
